title: Iterated integrals for generalized Appell functions
summary: Appell functions are a large class of multi-variable quasi-elliptic functions, which are also instances of higher depth mock modular forms. A central aspect of these functions is their non-holomorphic modular completion. Our previous work developed Appell functions for a general positive definite lattice $Λ$, and expressed the non-holomorphic completion in terms of the generalized error functions $M_P$, which are integrals over a $P$-dimensional hyperplane in $Λ\otimes \mathbb{C}$.
